correctness.rationale: Uniform feasible-edge deposition has exactly C(2k+l,2)-k available edges, partitioned into C(l,2),2kl,2k(k-1) transitions; terminal states are (1,0) or (0,2). The tagged-one-pair survival product is at most 3/[(2n-1)(2n+1)]; the tagged-two-pair union bound forces an asymptotically unique candidate at the intermediate 2L-vertex stage and yields n q_n ->3/4, with n^-1/3 rate from L=floor(n^(1/3)). Independently recalculated rational recurrence n=2..6: 0,1/5,8/65,1231/11375,562248/6062875. The finite computation is corroboration only, not a proof for all n. The inequalities and quantifier order n->infty then L->infty were read from actual RESULT.md.
residual_risks: The claimed 3/4 constant and upper bound concern the equal-rate feasible-edge process only; finite tests n<=6 are not an infinite proof.
